Serré, Member of Parliament for Nickel Belt and Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Energy and Natural Resources and to the Minister of Official Languages, and Viviane Lapointe, Member of Parliament for Sudbury, announced that eligible children under the age of 18 and adults with a valid Disability Tax Credit certificate can apply for the Canadian Dental Care Plan.
